fixtureOrigin: Synthetic New Recruit text exports. Labels, canonical targets, composition and selected equipment are independently transcribed from accepted current-source V2 facts. Point annotations are import metadata, not current price assertions.
expectedOwnership: Aggregate equipment belongs to the physical UNIT_INSTANCE. Composition rows retain canonical profile bindings without invented per-infantry weapon owners.
expectationNotes: Expected units follow export order; repeated canonicalId values denote distinct physical instances.
isWarlord null means the export does not establish assignment. An explicit Warlord establishes the other entries as non-Warlord.
Multiple canonicalProfileIds in one weapon selection denote one physical selected weapon with all of its canonical firing profiles.
optionalWargear sourceOptionId is accepted selection evidence; canonicalEquipmentIds/canonicalFieldPaths identify the existing selected equipment owner or exact canonical ability block.
